title: Lost Mary BM600 Fizzy Pineapple Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: The Fizzy Pineapple Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pods combine the bright, tangy sweetness of exotic Pineapple with a subtle, sparkling finish. The vibrant tropical notes land with a satisfying sharpness, while the effervescent exhale keeps the flavour feeling crisp and balanced from start to finish. Each pack includes two 2ml pods prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, delivering up to 600 puffs* per pod depending on usage. Designed for a smooth mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw, they provide a satisfying experience with no need for refilling or coil changes. Made exclusively for the Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these pods are quick and clean to install. Simply click a pod into the device and enjoy consistent flavour and vapour with every puff. *Puff counts are approximate and dependent on the length of each draw. Total puffs may vary.
